questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Professional tax deducted from the salary of an employee by the employer is allowed as a statutory deduction from gross salary under Section 16(iii) of the Income Tax Act.
Reason (R): The Constitution of India empowers state governments and local authorities to levy taxes on professions, trades, callings, and employments.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true but (R) is false
(A) is false but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english:
Assertion (A) is true: Under Section 16(iii) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, tax on employment (commonly known as Professional Tax) levied by or under any State law is allowable as a statutory deduction from gross salary in the financial year in which it is actually paid.
Reason (R) is true: Article 276 of the Constitution of India provides constitutional authority to State Legislatures and local municipal authorities to levy taxes for the benefit of the State on professions, trades, callings, and employments (subject to a maximum ceiling of ₹2,500 per person per annum).
Because Professional Tax is a distinct constitutional levy imposed directly on employment under Article 276, the Income Tax Act in Section 16(iii) specifically provides a deduction for this State tax so that an employee is not taxed on money already paid to the State under constitutional authority. Thus, Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) सही है: आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 16(iii) के तहत, किसी राज्य विधि के अंतर्गत कर्मचारी के वेतन से काटा और चुकाया गया व्यावसायिक कर (प्रोफेशनल टैक्स) 'वेतन से आय' की गणना करते समय वास्तविक भुगतान के आधार पर सकल वेतन से कटौती योग्य होता है।
कारण (R) सही है: भारतीय संविधान का अनुच्छेद 276 राज्य सरकारों और नगरपालिकाओं/स्थानीय निकायों को व्यवसायों, व्यापारों और रोजगार पर कर लगाने का संवैधानिक अधिकार देता है (जिसकी अधिकतम सीमा ₹2,500 प्रति वर्ष निर्धारित है)।
चूंकि व्यावसायिक कर राज्य द्वारा अनुच्छेद 276 के तहत रोजगार पर लगाया गया एक अनिवार्य संवैधानिक कर है, इसलिए केंद्र सरकार ने वेतनभोगी कर्मचारियों को दोहरे कराधान से राहत देने हेतु आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 16(iii) में इसकी कटौती का स्पष्ट प्रावधान किया है। अतः (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।

questions.question_english: A recognized private unaided minority school in Delhi is directed by the Directorate of Education to admit students from socially and educationally backward classes under a state quota policy. Can the school legally refuse?

questions.explanation_english: A recognized private unaided minority educational institution can legally refuse to comply with state quota directives. Article 15(5) explicitly carves out an exception for minority educational institutions: 'other than the minority educational institutions referred to in clause (1) of article 30'. Furthermore, in Pramati Educational & Cultural Trust (2014), the Supreme Court ruled that state reservation mandates or quotas under the RTE Act cannot be imposed on minority institutions (aided or unaided) as that would infringe upon their constitutional autonomy under Article 30(1) to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice. Consequently, state authorities cannot force a minority school to implement reservation quotas for backward classes, nor can they withdraw recognition for lawful exercise of this right.

questions.question_english: If an employee (such as a newly appointed teacher) fails to intimate their choice of tax regime to the Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) at the beginning of the Financial Year 2023-24, what is the mandatory course of action for the DDO regarding TDS deduction?
options_english: Stop salary disbursements entirely until the formal declaration is submitted
Deduct TDS using the New Tax Regime as the default option
Deduct TDS considering the Old Tax Regime
Deduct tax at a flat punitive rate of 30%
questions.explanation_english:
Effective from Financial Year 2023-24 (Assessment Year 2024-25), the Finance Act, 2023 amended Section 115BAC to make the New Tax Regime the default tax regime for all individual taxpayers. As clarified by the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) in Circular No. 04/2023 dated April 5, 2023:
1. The employer (DDO) is required to seek an intimation from each employee regarding their preferred tax regime for TDS under Section 192.
2. If an employee does not provide such intimation, it is mandatory for the DDO to presume that the employee is under the default New Tax Regime and compute and deduct TDS under Section 115BAC.
3. The employee retains the legal right to choose the Old Tax Regime at the time of filing their return of income under Section 139(1).
Hence, the DDO must deduct TDS under the New Tax Regime as the default option.
questions.explanation_hindi:
वित्त अधिनियम, 2023 द्वारा किए गए संशोधनों के अनुसार वित्तीय वर्ष 2023-24 (निर्धारण वर्ष 2024-25) से आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 115BAC के तहत नई कर व्यवस्था को सभी व्यष्टि करदाताओं के लिए 'डिफ़ॉल्ट' (स्वतः प्रभावी) कर व्यवस्था बना दिया गया है।
केंद्रीय प्रत्यक्ष कर बोर्ड (CBDT) के परिपत्र सं. 04/2023 (दिनांक 5 अप्रैल 2023) के अनुसार:
1. आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO) को प्रत्येक कर्मचारी से धारा 192 के तहत टीडीएस कटौती हेतु पसंदीदा कर व्यवस्था की सूचना मांगनी होगी।
2. यदि कर्मचारी कोई सूचना नहीं देता है, तो DDO के लिए यह अनिवार्य है कि वह डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से नई कर व्यवस्था (धारा 115BAC) के तहत ही टीडीएस की गणना और कटौती करे।

options_english: The constitutional validity and legislative competence of the Right to Education Act of 2009.
The extent of state regulation over private unaided and minority educational institutions.
The statutory mandate regarding complete abolition and prohibition of corporal punishment in schools.
The legal framework governing affirmative action reservation of seats for SC/ST students in Central Universities.
questions.explanation_english: In the landmark 11-judge bench decision of TMA Pai Foundation v. State of Karnataka (2002), the Supreme Court primarily determined the scope of fundamental rights under Article 19(1)(g) and Article 30(1), defining the extent to which the State can regulate private unaided and minority educational institutions.

key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) The extent of state regulation over private unaided and minority educational institutions.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In the landmark 11-judge bench decision of TMA Pai Foundation v. State of Karnataka (2002), the Supreme Court primarily determined the scope of fundamental rights under Article 19(1)(g) and Article 30(1), defining the extent to which the State can regulate private unaided and minority educational institutions.

questions.question_english: A Vice-Principal is designated as the PIO of a school. A teacher files an RTI application asking for the authenticated copy of the school’s general cash book for the previous financial year. The Vice-Principal rejects the request stating that financial records are subject to audit and thus exempt from RTI. What is the correct position of law?
options_english: The rejection is valid; official financial records are classified as confidential under GFR rules.
The rejection is valid; statutory audit regulations restrict cash book access exclusively to auditors.
The rejection is invalid, but financial details can only be shared with the SMC, not individual teachers.
The rejection is invalid; cash books are public records not exempt under Section 8(1).
questions.explanation_english: The rejection is invalid; cash books are public records not exempt under Section 8(1). Cash books, financial ledgers, and expenditure records held by public authorities constitute public records under Section 2(f). Ongoing or completed audits do not exempt financial records from disclosure under Section 8(1). Public Information Officers cannot deny access to general cash books requested by employees or citizens.

key_facts: Answer key: (D)

questions.question_english: Under Section 194C of the Income Tax Act, 1961 (Payments to Contractors), the threshold limit for deducting TDS for a single contract is ₹30,000. What is the aggregate monetary limit for payments credited or paid to a single contractor during a financial year beyond which TDS deduction becomes mandatory?
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 194C of the Income Tax Act, 1961, any specified person (including a school DDO/principal) responsible for paying any sum to a resident contractor for carrying out any work (including transport, maintenance, catering, housekeeping, security, etc.) must deduct tax at source. The statutory thresholds are dual: (1) TDS is attracted if a single sum credited or paid exceeds ₹30,000; OR (2) where the aggregate of sums credited or paid to that contractor during the financial year exceeds ₹1,00,000 (even if each individual payment was less than ₹30,000). Once the aggregate crosses ₹1,00,000, TDS is applicable on the entire cumulative amount at 1% for individual/HUF contractors and 2% for corporate/firm contractors.
questions.explanation_hindi: आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 194C के अंतर्गत, किसी निवासी ठेकेदार/संविदाकार (जैसे विद्यालय में रखरखाव, परिवहन, कैटरिंग, सुरक्षा आदि कार्य करने वाले) को भुगतान करते समय DDO को टीडीएस काटना होता है। इसके लिए दोहरी सीमा निर्धारित है: (1) यदि किसी एकल संविदा या बिल के भुगतान की राशि ₹30,000 से अधिक हो; अथवा (2) यदि वित्तीय वर्ष के दौरान उस एकल संविदाकार को किए गए या देय कुल भुगतानों की संचयी राशि ₹1,00,000 से अधिक हो जाती है (भले ही प्रत्येक व्यक्तिगत बिल ₹30,000 से कम का क्यों न रहा हो)। ₹1,00,000 की कुल सीमा पार होते ही पूरी संचयी राशि पर टीडीएस (व्यक्ति/HUF के लिए 1% तथा कंपनी/फर्म के लिए 2%) काटना अनिवार्य हो जाता है। अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प C (₹1,00,000) है।

questions.question_english: Section 16 of the POSH Act, 2013 strictly prohibits the publication or disclosure of which of the following information to the public, press, or media?
options_english: The information regarding the justice secured to any victim of sexual harassment without disclosing the identity
The total number of sexual harassment cases filed in the organization's annual report
The composition of the Internal Complaints Committee
The identity and addresses of the aggrieved woman, respondent, and witnesses
questions.explanation_english: Section 16 of the POSH Act, 2013 strictly prohibits the disclosure or publication of the contents of the complaint, the identity and addresses of the aggrieved woman, respondent, and witnesses, any information relating to conciliation and inquiry proceedings, or the recommendations of the Internal/Local Committee to the public, press, or media in any manner. Reason (R): The Supreme Court has repeatedly held that education is treated as a charitable occupation, not a trade or business for profit under Article 19(1)(g).

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): OLTAS stands for Online Tax Accounting System, which is an IT-based system responsible for the collection, accounting, and reporting of direct tax receipts from authorized banks to the Income Tax Department.
Reason (R): OLTAS introduced a simplified single-copy challan system, replacing the earlier cumbersome quadruplicate challan system to enable seamless electronic tracking and real-time transmission of tax data.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true, but (R) is false
(A) is false, but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english: The Online Tax Accounting System (OLTAS) was conceptualized and rolled out by the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) and the Reserve Bank of India to replace the archaic manual direct tax accounting system. Prior to OLTAS, taxpayers used multi-copy (quadruplicate) paper challans where copies were manually routed between bank branches, nodal branches, Zonal Accounts Offices (ZAO), and assessing officers, leading to huge reconciliatory discrepancies and delays. OLTAS eliminated this bottleneck by instituting a simplified single-copy challan system (ITNS 280, ITNS 281) accompanied by a unique Challan Identification Number (CIN) comprising the 7-digit BSR code, deposit date, and challan serial number. This structural innovation allowed authorized collecting bank branches to transmit encrypted tax data electronically on a daily basis directly to TIN/CBDT. Thus, both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) correctly explains how OLTAS achieves its operational mission of direct tax accounting.
questions.explanation_hindi: ऑनलाइन टैक्स अकाउंटिंग सिस्टम (OLTAS) प्रत्यक्ष करों (जैसे आयकर, निगम कर, टीडीएस) के संग्रहण, लेखांकन और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक सूचना संचरण की एक एकीकृत प्रणाली है। ओल्टास लागू होने से पहले करदाताओं को चार प्रतियों (quadruplicate) वाले जटिल कागजी चालान भरने पड़ते थे, जिनका बैंकों और आयकर कार्यालयों के बीच भौतिक रूप से आदान-प्रदान होता था जिससे भारी विसंगतियां और विलंब होता था। ओल्टास ने इस प्रक्रिया को आधुनिक बनाते हुए एकल प्रति (single-copy) चालान प्रणाली तथा अद्वितीय चालान पहचान संख्या (CIN - जिसमें 7 अंकों का BSR कोड, चालान की तारीख और क्रम संख्या होती है) लागू की। इसके माध्यम से अधिकृत बैंक शाखाएं प्रतिदिन एकत्र किए गए कर का डेटा इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप से आयकर नेटवर्क को प्रेषित करती हैं। अतः (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।

questions.question_english: A Principal of a newly constructed Delhi Government school notices that while there are ramps, they are too steep for a student to independently navigate a wheelchair, thereby violating accessibility norms. What is the standard recommended gradient for an accessible ramp in public buildings?
questions.explanation_english: According to the 'Harmonised Guidelines and Space Standards for Barrier Free Built Environment' notified under the RPwD Act, 2016 and the National Building Code of India (NBC), the standard recommended maximum gradient for a ramp in public buildings and schools is 1:12 (1 unit of vertical rise for every 12 units of horizontal run, representing an 8.33% slope). Steeper ramps (such as 1:8 or 1:10) create severe safety risks, including the danger of manual wheelchairs tipping backwards or slipping. The guidelines also stipulate that a ramp must have a minimum width of 1200 mm to 1500 mm, continuous handrails on both sides at 750 mm and 900 mm heights, a non-slip surface, and level landings of at least 1500 mm × 1500 mm every 9 metres of run.
questions.explanation_hindi: दिव्यांगजन अधिकार अधिनियम, 2016 के अधीन अधिसूचित 'बाधा-मुक्त निर्मित परिवेश हेतु समेकित दिशा-निर्देश' तथा राष्ट्रीय भवन निर्माण संहिता (NBC) के अनुसार, सार्वजनिक भवनों एवं विद्यालयों में रैंप के लिए मानक अनुशंसित अधिकतम ढलान 1:12 (प्रत्येक 12 इकाई क्षैतिज दूरी पर 1 इकाई ऊर्ध्वाधर उठान, अर्थात 8.33% प्रवणता) है। 1:12 से अधिक तीव्र ढलान (जैसे 1:8 या 1:10) पर व्हीलचेयर चलाना अत्यंत जोखिम भरा होता है और उपयोगकर्ता के पीछे पलटने का खतरा रहता है। इसके अतिरिक्त, मानकों के अनुसार रैंप की चौड़ाई न्यूनतम 1200 से 1500 मिमी होनी चाहिए, दोनों किनारों पर 750 मिमी व 900 मिमी की ऊंचाई पर दोहरी रेलिंग (हैंडरेल) होनी चाहिए, तथा प्रत्येक 9 मीटर की दौड़ के बाद 1500 मिमी × 1500 मिमी का समतल लैंडिंग स्थल होना अनिवार्य है।

questions.question_english: A school employs an external outsourced agency for transport services. A bus conductor sexually harasses a student. As per POCSO guidelines for schools, who is accountable for reporting this incident and ensuring safety protocols were in place?
options_english: Only the private transport agency owner managing the service
The School Management and Principal
The biological parents of the child involved in the incident
The local traffic police department having jurisdiction
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 19(1) of the POCSO Act, 2012, any person, including school authorities, heads of educational institutions, and management, who has apprehension or knowledge that an offence under the Act has been committed, has an absolute mandatory duty to report it immediately to the Special Juvenile Police Unit (SJPU) or the local police. Failure to report constitutes a criminal offence under Section 21. questions.explanation_hindi:
103वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2019 द्वारा जोड़े गए अनुच्छेद 15(6) और 16(6) की मूल शब्दावली के अनुसार, आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्गों (EWS) के लिए अनुमत आरक्षण की अधिकतम सीमा 10% (दस प्रतिशत) निर्धारित की गई है:

- अनुच्छेद 15(6)(b) के अनुसार: शैक्षणिक संस्थानों में प्रवेश हेतु यह आरक्षण 'मौजूदा आरक्षणों के अतिरिक्त होगा और प्रत्येक श्रेणी में कुल सीटों के अधिकतम दस प्रतिशत (10%) के अधीन होगा।'
- अनुच्छेद 16(6) के अनुसार: राज्य के अधीन पदों या नियुक्तियों में यह आरक्षण 'मौजूदा आरक्षण के अतिरिक्त होगा और प्रत्येक श्रेणी में पदों के अधिकतम दस प्रतिशत (10%) के अधीन होगा।'

यह 10% आरक्षण पहले से विद्यमान एससी (15%), एसटी (7.5%), और ओबीसी (27%) आरक्षण के अतिरिक्त है, जिससे केंद्र सरकार के तहत कुल ऊर्ध्वाधर (vertical) आरक्षण 59.5% हो गया है।
questions.topic: Constitutional Provisions for PwBD, EWS, SC, ST, and Disadvantaged Groups
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) 10%

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Article 15(6) and Article 16(6) introduced by the 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act, the maximum percentage of reservation permitted for Economically Weaker Sections is ten percent. This quota is granted in addition to existing reservations for SCs, STs, and OBCs, applying to educational admissions and public service appointments.
